verdict.rationale: Authy is a 2FA authenticator app with a companion developer API. Running it headlessly or in CI is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The pack shows no CLI, headless mode, or CI automation for the product. The SDK/API exists only so developers can embed 2FA in their own apps, which is a building block rather than headless operation. The probe also records that the Authy API is closed to new customers and slated for deprecation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
